newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper reshuffles cabinet again.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper reshuffles cabinet again.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper reshuffled his cabinet Friday, for the second time in a week, by appointing Agriculture Minister Cecilia Lopez to take over as head of the National Planning Department.

Lopez, a veteran member of Samper's government team who was originally appointed head of the Ministry of the Environment, confirmed her swap to the Planning Department in an interview with national radio.
"It's a prize for me really," Lopez told the Radionet radio news programme when asked about her new posting.
She identified her successor as Antonio Gomez Merlano, head of a government agency responsible for financing public works projects.

Lopez said she was unable to confirm reports that Samper had also appointed a new chief of the Environment Ministry, currently headed by Jose Vicente Mogollon. She said she was unable to comment on the fate of Juan Carlos Ramirez, her predecessor as director of the Planning Department.
In a reshuffle last Friday, Samper named new Labour and Foreign Trade ministers.
